title: Aubergine tomato bulgur
summary: Aubergine tomato bulgur is a mediterranean dinner built around aubergines and bulgur wheat, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Aubergine tomato bulgur. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add aubergines and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and bulgur wheat.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Aubergine tomato bulgur before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Aubergine tomato bulgur.  Serve with the bulgur, simmered in salted water until tender.
